currentParagraphText: “Can you explain what you’ll do?” Jake asked, more out of curiosity than anything else.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Can you explain what you’ll do?” Jake asked, more out of curiosity than anything else.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: The mask floated upwards, and Jake felt Yggdrasil prod for permission. Even as a Primordial, she couldn’t manipulate a Soulbound item without express permission from the user. It was a hard rule by the system, and unless she had a Transcendent skill or Bloodline to fuck with other people’s equipment, Jake had to give the go-ahead. Something he naturally did.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Without any hesitation, Jake took off the mask and offered it up.
